result.description:
Next Gen Talent
Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve drafting and design issues throughout project delivery.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential

result.description:
The Client: 

ZED Real Estate is an industry-disrupting, high-performance luxury property group and is known as one of the most digitally progressive real estate advisory firms in Australia. Due to their expanding international footprint of advisors and corporate offices spanning Melbourne, Queensland, and Dubai, their infrastructure requires enterprise-grade engineering and now seek an experienced Computer?Network and System Engineer to join the team in Hampton East, Victoria. 

?? 

The Role: 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $150,000 plus superannuation, and will be based in Hampton East, Victoria. 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Design, deploy, and manage secure, high-availability Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless environments across all corporate offices, including Hampton East (VIC), Mermaid Beach (QLD), and Dubai. 

Implement advanced networking technologies and configure routers, firewalls, and network switches to prioritise high-bandwidth traffic, ensuring seamless VoIP communication.  

Create, update, and maintain detailed technical documentation, including network inventories, configuration change logs, maintenance procedures, and fault resolution records. 

Design and deploy network configurations, incorporating high-availability routing protocols, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Quality of Service (QoS) rules, and secure site-to-site VPN tunnels. 

Implement SoftwareDefined Networking (SDN) and develop programmatic, APIdriven workflows across network hardware using automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, and RESTful integrations to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. 

Monitor and analyse network traffic, capacity, and utilisation metrics, and evaluate endtoend network infrastructure performance across all corporate office locations. 

Evaluate and propose technical enhancements to network operations, interconnected server infrastructure, internal hardware, distributed PropTech applications, and hybrid operational environments. 

Optimise 4K media-rendering architectures and secure localised Network attached Storage (NAS) configurations, improving internal high-volume data-pipeline workflows for the marketing division. 

Oversee network and system configurations to ensure smooth data flows between real estate-specific APIs, external listing syndications (e.g., Realestate.com.au, Domain), and internal master CRMs. 

Provision, test, and deploy complex server networks, cloud systems (Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID), and endpoint systems using modern Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. 

Formulate comprehensive testing strategies to validate network throughput, failover systems, and server redundancy, ensuring the agency maintains its strict zero-downtime metric during business hours. 

Provide expert troubleshooting and fault-finding services to isolate, diagnose, and resolve intricate network bugs, hardware failures, system anomalies, or cross-platform software conflicts. 

Troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, networks, software, database applications, servers, and workstations, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and maintaining high service standards. 

Actively contribute to ZED Real Estate’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) by supporting the implementation and upkeep of its policies, procedures and controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information in alignment with ISO/IEC?27001. 

Design and execute network security baselines, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Zero-Trust conditional access rules, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced endpoint detection systems. 

Architect and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) lifecycle workflows to enforce continuous security baselines across automated user onboarding and offboarding frameworks. 

Create, test, and preserve robust data backup structures, comprehensive disaster recovery workflows, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to secure sensitive real estate escrow accounts and high-net-worth data. 

 

The Requirements: 

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related ICT Major. 

At least 5 years of relevant professional experience as a Network Engineer, Systems Engineer, or ICT Systems Administrator in a corporate setting 

Professional infrastructure certifications are highly regarded (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+). 

At least 5 years demonstrated experience of core networking models and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, VPN, switching, routing). 

At least 5 years experience managing corporate directory platforms and infrastructure identities (Microsoft cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune). 

Must have over 5 years’ experience to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers 

Must know how to setup virtual configurations in VMWare vSphere and Hyper-V 

At least 5 years of experience with server virtualisation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid integration projects. 

Strong analytical skills and sound administration skills 

Quick to grasp new ideas and concepts 

Ability to work to tight deadlines and under immense pressure at times
